intent: Combine the RNA and the ATAC AnnData of one 10x multiome run into a single MuData that contains only the cells measured in both assays (paired cells), and save it as pbmc_multiome.h5mu so that a joint analysis can use it directly.
silent_error: MuData takes the union of the observations of its modalities (mdata.n_obs counts every cell seen in any modality; obsmap holds 0 for a missing cell). Building MuData({'rna': rna, 'atac': atac}) from objects with only partly overlapping barcodes therefore keeps cells that have data in one assay only, with empty rows in the other. No warning, exit 0; nothing intersects the cells, so downstream joint analysis silently includes unpaired cells.

files.make_multiome.py:
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
bc = ["AAACAGCCAAGGAATC", "AAACAGCCAATGCGCT", "AAACAGCCACACTAAT", "AAACAGCCACCAACCG", "AAACAGCCAGGATAAC",
      "AAACAGCCAGTAGGTG", "AAACAGCCAGTTTACG", "AAACAGCCATCCTTGC", "AAACATGCAAGGTCTG", "AAACATGCAGACACCG"]
rna_cells = [f"{b}-1" for b in bc[:8]]
atac_cells = [f"{b}-1" for b in bc[2:]]
rna = ad.AnnData(rng.poisson(3, size=(8, 5)).astype("float32"), obs=pd.DataFrame(index=rna_cells),
                 var=pd.DataFrame(index=["CD3E", "CD19", "LYZ", "NKG7", "ACTB"]))
atac = ad.AnnData(rng.poisson(1, size=(8, 4)).astype("float32"), obs=pd.DataFrame(index=atac_cells),
                  var=pd.DataFrame(index=["chr1:1000-1500", "chr1:5000-5600", "chr2:700-1300", "chr3:900-1400"]))
rna.write_h5ad("pbmc_rna.h5ad")
atac.write_h5ad("pbmc_atac.h5ad")
files.build_mudata.py:
import anndata as ad
import mudata as md

md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)
rna = ad.read_h5ad("pbmc_rna.h5ad")
atac = ad.read_h5ad("pbmc_atac.h5ad")
mdata = md.MuData({"rna": rna, "atac": atac})
mdata.write_h5mu("pbmc_multiome.h5mu")
files.build_mudata_v2.py:
import anndata as ad
import mudata as md

md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)
rna = ad.read_h5ad("pbmc_rna.h5ad")
atac = ad.read_h5ad("pbmc_atac.h5ad")
paired = rna.obs_names.intersection(atac.obs_names)
rna = rna[paired].copy()
atac = atac[paired].copy()
mdata = md.MuData({"rna": rna, "atac": atac})
mdata.write_h5mu("pbmc_multiome.h5mu")
